subtitle: One long smoke up front, then two fast nights that live off it. Cook them in order so the pork and the corn carry forward.

meals.name: Smoked Pulled Pork Sandwiches
meals.blurb: A 3 lb shoulder, sweet-and-savory rub, no twine — smoked to probe-tender and pulled into brioche buns.
ingredients: 2 tbsp yellow mustard (binder only — it won’t taste like mustard)
Wood chips or pellets — cherry, hickory, or pecan

det: ¼ cup packed brown sugar
2 tbsp sweet paprika
1 tbsp kosher salt
2 tsp garlic powder + 1½ tsp onion powder
1 tsp coarse black pepper + 1 tsp mustard powder
Stir it all together, breaking up any brown-sugar clumps

prep.t: Trim, slather, and rub the shoulder
det: Trim off loose, thin, dangling meat and stray fat strings so they don’t burn
Leave the main ¼-inch fat cap intact
Pat the whole roast dry with paper towels
Slather every surface with 2 tbsp yellow mustard
Coat all sides generously with the rub and press it in with your hands
Set the smoker to 225–250°F
Add cherry, hickory, or pecan wood chips or pellets
Let it settle at temp before the pork goes on

cook.t: Tuck the roast and get it on
det: Gather the loose flaps of the boneless cut and tuck them tightly underneath
Set it straight on the grate, fat-side up — no twine needed
Gravity holds it together as the meat shrinks and tightens
Close the lid
3 to 3½ hours at 225–250°F
Don’t peek, don’t spritz, don’t open the lid
You’re looking for ~160°F internal and a dark, firmly set crust
Lay out a double layer of heavy-duty foil
Transfer the shoulder onto it, tucked flaps still underneath
Wrap as tightly as you can to trap the steam and juices
Back into the smoker

cook.t: The stall phase — cook to probe-tender
det: Another 1½ to 2½ hours wrapped
Watch it with the remote digital thermometer
Done at 195–205°F in the thickest part
The real test: the probe slides into the center with zero resistance
Pull it off the smoker and leave it in the foil
Rest on the counter 30–45 min
This is what keeps the juices in the meat instead of on the board
Shuck 3 ears of sweet corn and rub them with butter, salt, and pepper
Set the other 2 ears aside raw, still in the husk, for tomorrow
Open the can of baked beans into a small pot
Set out the buns and the BBQ sauce

cook.t: Roast the corn and warm the beans
det: Corn at 425°F in the oven (or back on the smoker), turning once, about 20 min
Baked beans on low, stirring now and then
Unwrap carefully over a pan — save every drop of the liquid pork juice
Pull the meat apart with two forks, discarding big chunks of unrendered fat
Pour the saved juices back over the shredded pork to rehydrate it
Set aside 1 lb of the pork UNSAUCED for tomorrow
Toss the rest with Sweet Baby Ray’s to taste
Pile the sauced pork onto brioche buns
Serve with the roasted corn and baked beans

leftovers: Fridge the sauced pork up to 4 days; it reheats best with a splash of water.
Lunch: pork over rice, or a second sandwich.
Remember: 1 lb stays unsauced and 2 ears of corn stay raw for Night 2.

meals.name: Pulled Pork & Charred Corn Quesadillas
meals.blurb: Last night’s pork, re-seasoned bright with chili and lime — crisped in a pan with charred corn and black beans.

det: Shuck the 2 ears of corn and cut the kernels off into a bowl
Dice ½ red onion — put the other half in the fridge for tomorrow
Chop the cilantro (stems and all)
Drain and rinse the can of black beans
Zest and juice 1 lime; cut the second into wedges
Stir the lime crema: ½ cup sour cream + the lime zest + a squeeze of juice + pinch of salt
Toss the 1 lb pulled pork with 1 tsp chili powder, ½ tsp cumin, and the rest of the lime juice
Now it’s all grab-and-go
Hot dry skillet, a little olive oil
Corn kernels and diced onion, undisturbed 2 min, then toss
Cook until the kernels have real black spots
Stir in the black beans and half the cilantro, then tip it all into a bowl
Same pan, medium heat
The seasoned pork, 3–4 min, until hot and a little crispy at the edges
Tortilla in the pan, cheese on half, then pork, then the corn-bean mix, then more cheese
Fold over and press flat
2–3 min a side until deep golden and the cheese has set
Work in batches — 4 quesadillas total
Cut each into thirds
Top with the rest of the cilantro
Lime crema and lime wedges on the side

leftovers: Reheat in a dry pan, not the microwave — the tortilla goes soft otherwise.
Lunch: cut cold into wedges with the leftover crema.

meals.name: Crispy Lemon-Herb Chicken Thighs
meals.blurb: Skin-shattering skillet-to-oven thighs with roasted asparagus and lemon-garlic parmesan orzo.

det: Pat the thighs bone-dry with paper towels — dry skin is the whole trick
Salt them on both sides and leave them out while you do the rest
Snap or trim the woody ends off 1 lb asparagus
Slice the ½ red onion from last night into thin wedges
Zest 1 lemon and cut it into wedges; slice the second into thin rounds
Grate 3 cloves garlic and chop the parsley
Melt 4 tbsp butter and stir in the garlic and lemon zest
Heat the oven to 425°F
Thighs skin-down in a cold, dry cast-iron skillet, then turn the heat to medium-high
Starting cold renders the fat instead of seizing the skin
12–14 min undisturbed — no poking, no peeking
The skin releases on its own when it's ready

cook.t: Flip and finish in the oven
det: Flip skin-up, tuck the lemon rounds around them
Brush with the lemon-garlic butter — hold back about a third for the orzo
425°F for 12–15 min, to 175°F internal
Asparagus and red onion on a sheet pan, olive oil, salt, pepper
Same 425°F oven, on the rack below the chicken
Well-salted water, 1½ cups orzo, 8–9 min
Reserve ¼ cup of the water, then drain
Orzo + the reserved lemon-garlic butter
Splash of the pasta water and ½ cup parmesan
Stir until glossy, then most of the parsley
Salt and pepper to taste
Rest the thighs 5 min — skin-up so it stays crisp
Orzo down first, chicken and vegetables on top
The rest of the parsley and a lemon wedge each

leftovers: Lunch: chop the chicken into the orzo with an extra squeeze of lemon.
Reheat in a hot dry pan skin-down to bring the crisp back — the microwave will ruin it.

items.note: Smoke Night 1; 1 lb pulled goes to Night 2
CHECK LABEL: no apple, apple juice, or cider vinegar
